Name: Content patcher language pattern
Author: Mazzons
Description:
Like the introduction, this is only a pattern for modders to help them to know how a good way to separate the files, and maintain multiple languages on the same mod in the best way possible.

the architecture of files will be like this, only put inside what have the dialogs about the language itself, others things like assets and schedules put in the same level of I18.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]


on the content.json you will have always two changes for one change itself, one to get the default (will put this if not have a translation to the change you want.
﻿the defaultLanguage you put in the ConfigSchema, or set manually to one language you want, I prefer this way because give a possibility to change the default language without change in all fromFile, or like if the people don't want the new content don't have in their language, don't show the rest.

"FromFile": "i18/{{DefaultLanguage}}/dialogue/manifestation.json",
"When": {"HasFile: i18/{{Language}}/dialog/manifestation.json": false}

to get in all languages make a copy of the previous object (data, LogName,action,target)

[code][/code][quote][code] "FromFile": "i18/{{Language}}/dialogue/manifestation.json",
"When": {"HasFile: i18/{{Language}}/dialogue/manifestation.json": true}
[/code]
﻿[/quote]
this way will get the file in the language the player are.
